        cols = [p[1] for p in b]

        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Black interior: center~({(min(rows)+max(rows))//2}, {(min(cols)+max(cols))//2}), span={max(rows)-min(rows)}x{max(cols)-min(cols)}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

containers = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'c' and n['pixels'] == 8]
print(f"Containers: {len(containers)}")
